newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open flat to 0.10 lower.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open flat to 0.10 lower.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent weaker Wednesday, based on market orders at 1017 EDT, traders said.
Activity is expected to remain rangebound and thin ahead of the U.S. Independence Day holiday Friday. NYCE will reopen Monday.
The benchmark December contract closed down 0.29 cent at 76.83 cents a lb Tuesday after trading from 77.35 to 76.76 cents. The rest settled 0.32 to 0.20 lower.
An estimated 8,500 lots changed hands on the day.
Resistance in December remained at 77.70 to 77.95 cents, with support at 76.10 cents.
NYCE said six notices were issued today, bringing total notices to date to 762.
